2. If an employee has worked for an employer for less than 12 months, the number of annual leave days shall be proportional to the number working months.
3. If the employee has not taken annual leave or has not had all of annual leave days due to resignation or loss of job, the employer shall pay the wage for the remaining leave days.

An employee may agree with the employer on taking annual leave in installments or in groups for up to every three years. The employee may reach agreement with the employers on taking multiple annual leaves or a pool for up every three consecutive years. In this case, the number of leave days of an employee shall depend on the working time and nature of the job. An employee may negotiate with the employer about a vacation allowance pool.
